lines.zh: 星光落在海面 泛起旧日涟漪
lines.en: Starlight falls upon the sea, stirring old ripples

lines.zh: 拾起散落的碎片 拂去岁月微尘
lines.en: Picking up scattered shards, brushing off dust of time

lines.zh: 每一片微光 都藏着我们的曾经
lines.en: Every glimmer holds the days we once shared

lines.zh: 晚风轻轻吹过 海边的旧站台
lines.en: Evening breeze drifts across the old seaside platform

lines.zh: 把散落的温柔 一一拼回你掌心
lines.en: Piecing every scattered tenderness back into your palm

lines.zh: 我们之间的回忆
lines.en: All the memories between the two of us

lines.zh: 全部都小心地收集
lines.en: Every single one carefully gathered and kept

lines.zh: 我总是偷偷地哭泣
lines.en: I always find myself crying in secret

lines.zh: 像倦鸟失了归期
lines.en: Like a weary bird that lost its way home

lines.zh: 但愿我相信的爱情
lines.en: May the love I have always believed in

lines.zh: 结局紧握在我手心
lines.en: Hold its ending tightly within my palm

lines.zh: 时光匆匆却没有遗失过去
lines.en: Time rushes by, yet never lost our past

lines.zh: 时光匆匆却没有遗失过去
lines.en: Every memory still shines through the fleeting years

lines.zh: 希望我们 有光明的未来
lines.en: Hoping that we will share a bright future ahead

lines.zh: 还有能够装下星空的期待
lines.en: And expectations vast enough to hold the starry sky

lines.zh: 可现实为何让我感到如此懈怠
lines.en: Yet why does reality leave me feeling so weary

lines.zh: 总怀念相遇时我们无视落叶和人海
lines.en: Missing when we first met, oblivious to falling leaves and crowds

lines.zh: 是你让我勇敢不再像颗尘埃
lines.en: It was you who made me brave, no longer a speck of dust

lines.zh: 是你常帮我照料装着梦的盆栽
lines.en: It was you who tended the bonsai holding all my dreams

lines.zh: 每一天我们都是如此愉快
lines.en: Every single day we spent together was so joyful

lines.zh: 一直到天色渐晚看着落日无奈离开
lines.en: Until dusk fell and we watched the sunset, parting reluctantly

lines.zh: 我知道你爱集邮爱笑甚至爱发呆
lines.en: I know you love collecting stamps, smiling, and daydreaming

lines.zh: 我知道你怕草虫还有夜晚的妖怪
lines.en: I know you fear grass-bugs and little monsters of the night

lines.zh: 我喜欢你有一点心不在焉的状态
lines.en: I love the way you look when you are slightly absent-minded

lines.zh: 看起来像个回到七岁时候的小孩
lines.en: Looking just like a child back when you were seven years old

lines.zh: 该如何将我这份感情向你告白
lines.en: How should I confess all of these feelings in my heart to you

lines.zh: 喜欢却又不敢爱 直到整个宇宙
lines.en: Fond of you yet afraid to love, until the whole universe

lines.zh: 在为我焦虑失神慌张之中醒来
lines.en: Awakens amidst my anxious, dazed, and flustered heart

lines.zh: 就像是黑暗过后黎明盛开
lines.en: Just like daybreak blooming across the sky after darkness

lines.zh: 独自收集两个人之间的回忆
lines.en: Collecting the memories between the two of us all alone

lines.zh: 即使每当到这时候我都会哭泣
lines.en: Even though every time this moment comes I still cry

lines.zh: 为何一切 变得如此
lines.en: Why did everything change and become like this

lines.zh: 无法回到过去
lines.en: Unable to ever return to the past we knew

lines.zh: 但我仍愿意感谢你给过我爱情
lines.en: Yet I am still grateful for the love you once gave me

lines.zh: 每一场风景都是我们爱的证明
lines.en: Every scenery we passed is proof of our love

lines.zh: 就算如今 天各一方
lines.en: Even if today we stand beneath distant skies

lines.zh: 祝你余生动听啊
lines.en: I wish the rest of your life a beautiful melody
